verdict.rationale: GitHub's core version control (git history, PRs, branch protection) inherently supports versioning, review, and rollback of any code-based automation (e.g., Actions workflows, scripts), and evidence shows CI/CD and PR review features (github-docs-11, github-docs-9). However, the evidence pack lacks specific documentation about versioning/reviewing/rolling back AI-native automations themselves (e.g., Copilot agent tasks, custom instructions, or workflow configs) as distinct artifacts. missing for 10: explicit docs on treating AI-agent automations/prompts as versioned artifacts, rollback mechanisms specific to Copilot-generated changes or agent workflows, and independent corroboration of this review/rollback flow for automations.
